_comment: Sections of the 1+MG Data Governance master document, as published in the annex (section 7) of GDI D2.4. 'id' is the section number used in <GovRef id="…" /> and in governance_refs. Always cross-reference the governance by section number, never by page number. Section IV (overview tables) and its subsections IV.1–IV.4 are numbered 'I.' and 'I.1'–'I.4' in the published document; 'printed_as' gives that number. The topic headings inside the overview tables are not numbered and are not listed: cite the matching sections in chapters V–VIII. Titles follow the published document; two obvious slips are corrected (VII.1.4 'Responsivity', VIII.4 missing 'the SPE'). 'pdf_url' is an unchanged copy of the published PDF (pdf_source on Zenodo, CC BY 4.0, same pdf_md5), served by this site because Zenodo sends the file as a download, which ignores #page. 'pdf_page' is the page of that PDF where the section starts, taken from the PDF's bookmarks; 'pdf_dest' is the named destination at the section heading (the heading ids of the original document, matched to each heading by its position on the page). It is used only as a link target (#page=N), so that <GovRef> opens the PDF at the section; the text still cites the section number, never the page (decision D-035).
